content: The World Health Organization (WHO) Steering Group will continue to monitor advancements in research related to early childhood development (ECD), particularly in areas where the quality of evidence has been assessed as low or very low. If the guideline requires an update or if there are concerns that one or more recommendations may no longer be valid, WHO will initiate a formal update process in accordance with the procedures outlined in the WHO Handbook for Guideline Development (2014). As the guideline approaches its five-year review period, WHO, in collaboration with its partners, will conduct a comprehensive search for new evidence to ensure the recommendations remain current and evidence-based.
